paragraphs: Villain checks. Hero bets $135. Villain calls.

This is one of the rare situations where Hero should bet for thin value and protection. The number of combos that beat Hero is very small in comparison to the number of Broadway hands he should protect against. At most, Villain has 9-9, 4-4, 3-3, 10-10, and A-9 - 9-7s. That’s 35 combos ahead of Hero. Compare that to as many as 144 Broadway combos that have about 24% equity against Hero’s hand. There are also worse hands like 7-7,6-6, 5-5, 5-4s, and 6-5s that have to call at least one bet.
